plugins.name: file-based-memory
plugins.description: Persistent, resumable file-based memory: routed entrypoint, operational dashboard, four-layer durable memory, size discipline, supersede-don't-delete history, multi-workline mode (per-line handoff blocks, router rows), a status-stamped doc index with path#symbol pointers, precommit doc gates, auto-checkpoint cadence hook, and the /bootstrap + /save-status commands. Survives context resets and /clear.

plugins.name: review-discipline
plugins.description: Structured reviewer-pass disciplines for code, specs, and test fixtures: review-code, review-spec, review-fixtures. Apply a fixed verification taxonomy as an executable contract, emit findings keyed to named rows/checks with severity and a verdict.

plugins.name: eval-as-code-governance
plugins.description: Govern a retrieval / ML eval suite as first-class code: decouple gold from the corpus surface, the L1-L8 design checklist, the failure->action loop, four coverage detectors, looseness-symmetry guardrails, and the two-lane rule.

plugins.name: decision-ledger
plugins.description: Who decided what, on disk: user rulings recorded verbatim and dated apart from agent recommendations, an honest status ladder (proposed → recommended → ruled → landed → verified), open-question register with carried holes, and one debt register with stable ids. /ruling and /debt commands plus a precommit ledger gate.

plugins.name: engineering-discipline
plugins.description: Portable engineering discipline for agent-driven development: a verbatim principles ledger, field rules for parallel agent sessions and paid API calls, how to grow and cap your own principles file, /promote-memory, and a precommit ceiling gate.
